facts.text: Aylen tries to confront a thing that torments her.
Aylen tries to confront the thing and maybe even fight it.
The thing seems amused by Aylen's attempts.
The thing taunts Aylen by saying "Over here!"
The thing vanishes after saying "Over here!"
Aylen flails around trying to hit the thing.
Aylen confronts the thing and asks why it is going to destroy the world.
Aylen confronts the thing and asks why it is making her watch.
Aylen develops a test to ensure she is actually in the real world.
Aylen's test is kind of like the Inception concept.
Aylen performs the test before trying to confide in Sarah.
The test confirms that Aylen is in reality.
Aylen pours her heart out to her friend Sarah.

keyphrases: "you know what you have to do" quote
dialogue between Aylen and the thing

events.text: Aylen tries to confront the tormenting thing in broad daylight.
Aylen attempts to fight the thing but cannot touch it; it taunts her with "Over here!" and vanishes.
Aylen confronts the thing and asks why it will destroy the world and why it is making her watch.
Aylen develops and uses an Inception-like test to confirm reality before confiding in Sarah, then pours her heart out.
